title: Rendezvous at the Winter's Hearth
overview: No notes were recorded for this session. The party met at the Winter's Hearth.

title: Goblin Guide and Cave Standoff
overview: The session begins at the roadside ambush, where the party subdues Craig and questions him about the missing dwarf and armored traveler, learning both were taken alive to Klarg’s hideout several miles north. The group tends wounds, negotiates Craig’s cooperation, hides their wagon and horses, and then travels on foot up the narrow goblin trail under Craig’s warnings about traps. Francis scouts ahead and detects a snare and a concealed pit, which he safely triggers with a thrown stone before the party continues toward the cave. At the cave mouth, the group is ambushed by goblins hidden among the shadows, resulting in a chaotic fight involving healing, spellcasting, melee pressure, and the goblin boss’s redirect ability. After defeating the ambushers and glimpsing wolves in a side chamber, the party decides they are too wounded and low on resources to delve deeper toward Klarg. They withdraw to a safer point along the trail and set up a forest camp, assigning watches and settling in for a long rest.
where_we_left_off: By the session’s end, the party has retreated from the cave and established a campsite, complete with assigned watches and a lit fire to support those without darkvision. Their wagon and horses remain hidden far behind them, and Craig stays in custody as they plan to confront Klarg after resting. The goblins, wolves, and deeper tunnels of the hideout remain unexplored, and the fate of the abducted dwarf and armored human is still uncertain. The session closes as the party prepares to complete their long rest and return to the hideout at dawn.
scenes: Interrogating Craig and Managing the Ambush Site
Hiding the Wagon and Proceeding on Foot

title: Dreams, Wolves, and a Hostage
overview: The party completes a long rest in a forest camp with Craig bound nearby, preparing to move on the goblin hideout before dawn. During the night, several characters experience vivid, personal dreams that deliver cryptic warnings or guidance tied to their pasts and abilities. A brief disruption during first watch breaks the camp’s calm but does not draw outside danger. In the morning, the group enters the cave system, feeds chained wolves to avoid combat, and advances toward a rope bridge guarded by a sleeping goblin. A giant snake attack and a sudden flood trap escalate the situation, and the session ends as goblins respond aggressively and threaten a captive named Sildar.
where_we_left_off: The party is deep inside the goblin cave after surviving a snake attack, calming chained wolves, and enduring a flood trap. Goblins are fully alerted, ranged attacks are in play, and combat is ongoing. The session ends on a hostage standoff with Sildar’s life at immediate risk.
scenes: Into the Cave and Hungry Wolves
The Rope Bridge and Sleeping Sentry
Giant Snake on the Cave Approach

title: A Knife Before the Crown
overview: The session began with a tense hostage standoff as Yeemik held Sildar Hallwinter at knifepoint on a narrow ledge above the party. Negotiations revealed that the goblins were operating under pressures tied to Klarg, King Grol, and a mysterious figure known as the Spider. When covert spellcasting was detected, the standoff collapsed into violence. Sildar was gravely wounded but ultimately saved through quick intervention. Rather than withdraw, the party chose to push deeper into the hideout while goblin resistance was fractured and leadership uncertain. Several interior skirmishes followed as remaining goblins attempted to delay and regroup. The session culminated in a prolonged fight in Klarg’s den, where Klarg attempted to flee but became trapped and was killed along with his wolf. With Klarg dead and Yeemik neutralized, organized goblin leadership in the cave was broken. The party ended the session in control of the hideout, with new questions raised about the Spider’s influence.
where_we_left_off: With Klarg dead and Yeemik neutralized, the Cragmaw hideout fell silent. Remaining goblins scattered or surrendered, unable to mount further resistance. The party secured the cave and assessed the aftermath of the fighting. Sildar remained alive but critically injured, his survival owed entirely to the party’s actions during the standoff. Yeemik’s statements and the evidence within the den raised unresolved questions about King Grol and the Spider, making it clear that this victory had exposed a far larger threat. The session ended with the party in control of the hideout, aware that Klarg’s death was not the end of the conflict, but the beginning of a much wider struggle.

title: Secrets in the Aftermath
overview: The party begins in Klarg’s cavern after the battle, sorting through the stolen goods, healing their wounds, and deciding what to do with the surviving goblin and the cave’s chained wolves. They uncover crates marked with the blue lion of the Lionshield Coster, a chest full of coins, potions of healing, and a small jade statuette, then use one potion to bring Francis back from unconsciousness while discussing Vexhar’s furtive feeding on Klarg’s corpse. They negotiate with their goblin ally about caring for the wolves and ultimately decide to feed Klarg’s body to the animals and then free them before leaving the hideout with goblins helping haul the heavy crates. After returning to the wagon, Sildar reveals the truth about Gundren’s discovery of Wave Echo Cave, his own mission for the Lord’s Alliance, and the disappearance of his contact Iarno Albrek, giving the group new, urgent objectives in and around Phandalin. The party travels to Phandalin with the disguised goblin Craig, parts ways temporarily with Sildar as he heads to the Stonehill Inn, and drives the wagon to Barthen’s Provisions to deliver Gundren’s shipment. There they collide with a pair of red-cloaked thugs leaving the shop, learn from Elmina about the Redbrands’ protection rackets and Gundren’s worried friends, get paid for the delivery, and finish the session stepping back into the street with a lighter wagon and several new leads.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with the party leaving Barthen’s Provisions, dragging the still-groggy Levon out, and loading him to rest in the back of a now-lighter wagon that still carries a few Lionshield crates. Elmina asks them to let Gundren know she is worried if they find him, and they in turn promise they will not leave him out there alone. The group plans to head toward the tavern and eventually the Stonehill Inn to regroup with Sildar, with Gundren’s rescue, the Redbrands’ harassment, and the mystery of Wave Echo Cave all explicitly hanging as unresolved goals.
scenes: Feeding Wolves and Letting Them Go
Loading the Wagon and Sildar’s Truth

title: Lionshield Reward and Stonehill Revelations
overview: The party re-entered Phandalin, noticed the town’s wary mood, and chose to immediately return the Lion’s Shield crates they recovered from the goblins. At the Lion’s Shield Coster, they met Lenine Greywind, secured a 50 gp reward, and learned that the Redbrands have been acting openly because local leadership is not pushing back. Lenine offered a standing 10% discount if the group could get Harbin Wester at the Townmaster’s Hall to take action, but the party also had to rein in their own talk of “murder” to keep the conversation from going sideways. The group then pursued leads on healing supplies and took on a shrine-related errand involving a vain banshee near Conyberry and a jeweled silver comb. By night, they gathered at the Stonehill Inn to compare notes with Toblen and Sildar, confirm Gundren’s disappearance, and hear fresh accusations that the Redbrands murdered a local man and caused further disappearances.
where_we_left_off: The session ended with the party settled at the Stonehill Inn, having confirmed Gundren is missing and hearing renewed claims tying the Redbrands to murder and additional disappearances. They held multiple active leads, including confronting Harbin Wester, investigating the Redbrands’ presence in town, and pursuing the shrine’s banshee-and-comb errand near Coneyberry. The immediate danger remained unresolved, with the inn conversation highlighting that Phandalin has no real law enforcement to intervene on the town’s behalf.
scenes: Stonehill Inn News and Missing Gundren

title: Visiting Alvin and the Redbrands
overview: The session opens late at the Stonehill Inn as the party recaps what they know about Gundren’s kidnapping, the growing Redbrand threat, and recent rumors of murder in the streets. After deciding they are too exhausted to act, they head to bed and set plans to chase down better information in the morning. The next day, they visit Levon’s father Alvin at his farm, share food, question him about the Redbrands and the “spider” tied to Gundren, and talk through Levon’s strange eyes and a debt owed to a forbidden tree. Alvin cannot identify the spider but suggests that if trouble is tied to Phandalin, the Redbrands are likely involved or at least informed, pushing the group to confront them. From there the party meets with Harbin and Sildar to lock in rewards and contracts, then marches to the Sleeping Giant, where an encounter with Redbrand ruffians erupts into a bloody fight that ends with one survivor ready for interrogation.
where_we_left_off: When the fighting stops, the Redbrands who confronted the party outside the Sleeping Giant lie dead or incapacitated, with only one left conscious and restrained in Caine’s grip. The group discusses tying this survivor to interrogate him about the Redbrand operation, Tresendar Manor, and any connection to Gundren or the strange goblin. Session ends on this cliffhanger, with the captured Redbrand surrounded by the party and ready to be questioned at the start of the next session.
scenes: Late Night at the Stonehill Inn

title: Blood and Bone in Tresendar
overview: The party spends the opening of the session deciding what to do with their captured Redbrand, Johnny, ultimately choosing to spare his life in exchange for information and hard labor instead of execution. Using his directions, they plan an infiltration of the Redbrand hideout under Tresendar Manor, disguising themselves in stolen crimson cloaks and distributing healing resources before heading out. Inside the cellar beneath the ruined manor, they quietly explore, recover a hidden satchel of valuables from the cistern, locate a secret door, and engage a squad of Redbrands in their barracks, where one briefly traps Levon and Francis in a room before the group prevails and loots the bodies. Pressing on, they discover prison cells holding battered captives and a locked strongbox of coin and gemstones, then carefully rope their way across a dangerous crevasse that nearly claims Craig. The session ends in the family crypt, where skeletal guardians relentlessly focus their attacks on Craig, dropping him to the brink of death before a natural 20 on his final death save brings him back to consciousness at one hit point, still prone and surrounded as the battle rages on.
where_we_left_off: The session ends in the middle of the crypt battle, with skeletal archers and swordsmen still standing and several party members crowded in the doorway and along the walls. Craig has just regained consciousness at one hit point after a miraculous death save and remains prone and extremely vulnerable on the floor. The rest of the party is still engaged in a tight, dangerous fight with the undead guardians, and the fates of both the adventurers and the nearby prisoners remain unresolved as we pause play.
scenes: Infiltrating the Cellar at Tresendar Manor
Freeing Prisoners and Crossing the Crevasse

title: Echoes in the Redbrand Crypt
overview: The session opens with introductions and a recap that brings everyone back to Tresendar Manor’s crypt, where Craig survived on a natural 20 death save and the party still faces skeletal guardians and a trapped Redbrand. The group experiments with how the red cloaks affect the undead, then finishes the fight, destroys the remaining skeletons, and barricades the crypt so they can safely take a short rest. From there, they push deeper into the hideout, discovering a prison block where they defeat a Redbrand guard and free Mirna Dendrar and her children, learning of an heirloom tied to Thundertree. They escort the family out through the caves and then loot a well-stocked armory filled with Redbrand weapons and extra cloaks. Finally, the party finds a hidden passage leading back toward the central crevasse, where an unseen presence speaks directly into their minds just as the session ends.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with the party standing in the crevasse chamber, freshly aware that an unknown entity is watching and communicating with them telepathically. Mirna and her children are safely outside the hideout, but Glasstaff and the remaining Redbrands remain at large elsewhere in the complex. The next session will open with the heroes deciding how to answer the unseen voice and whether to treat it as foe, ally, or something in between.
scenes: Smuggling Prisoners Out Through the Caves
Looting the Armory and Finding a Secret
Approaching the Crevasse and Unseen Voice

title: Secrets for Food with the Nothic
overview: The party begins in the crevasse chamber beneath the manor, where a telepathic presence presses into their thoughts and soon reveals itself as a twisted, one-eyed creature later named Ssarnak. Through tense back-and-forth, it probes their secrets, offers information, and demands both knowledge and corpses in return for its cooperation. Broc climbs into the crevasse, discovers warped goblin bodies, and confirms the Nothic has been feeding on anything that causes trouble in the caverns. A series of shaky truces gives the party directions toward the wizard’s quarters and a glimpse of a gem-filled chest, but mistrust eventually erupts into open combat and the creature is slain. Later, the group loots the chest, debates whether to press on or withdraw, returns to town for a long rest and downtime, and then heads back to the hideout. The session ends with the heroes locked in a brutal staircase battle against bugbears and red-cloaked thugs as they push deeper toward the wizard’s domain.
where_we_left_off: The session closes with the party still in the thick of the staircase battle against bugbears and red-cloaked thugs inside the hideout. Several enemies have fallen, including the bugbear Nosk and at least one other foe dropped by Broc’s Mind Sliver, but multiple opponents remain engaged with the front line. The heroes have resources left but are clearly in a dangerous position, and the wizard who commands these guards is still unaccounted for somewhere deeper in the complex. Open questions include whether the remaining enemies can be broken or convinced to stand down and how quickly the wizard will react to the ongoing fighting.
scenes: Downtime in Town and Bugbear Greeting
Bugbear and Redbrand Battle on Stairs

title: Stairs of Blood and Spider’s Warning
overview: The session resumes in the middle of the staircase battle within the hideout, with bugbears and red-cloaked thugs still pressing the party’s position. After a hard-fought exchange in the choke point, the heroes eliminate the remaining enemies and secure the area. In the aftermath, they confirm that the wizard has fled, having used their earlier rest to escape rather than risk direct confrontation. While searching the hideout, they uncover correspondence from the Spider referencing a “drow arcanist,” signaling that larger forces are aware of Vexhar and possibly tracking the party. With the immediate threat neutralized, the group regroups in one of the common rooms and drinks from the Redbrands’ stores, leading to Vexhar becoming poisoned while Francis remains unaffected. By the end of the session, the party levels up to 3, marking a clear step forward in power as the conflict expands beyond the manor.
where_we_left_off: The staircase battle is won, the hideout is secured, and Glasstaff has escaped. The Spider’s note confirms that Vexhar is known to outside forces. The final image of the session is Francis quietly observing a tied-up goblin still snoring in the southern room, leaving that thread unresolved as the party prepares for what comes next.
scenes: Securing the Hideout and the Wizard’s Escape

title: Droop Freed and Road to Wyvern Tor
overview: The session begins with introductions and the Question of the Day before the DM summarizes events that occurred just before the recording began. The party has cleared the Redbrand hideout and discovered a captured goblin named Droop, who they free and question for information. Droop explains his background as a scavenger goblin and shares what he knows about Glasstaff, the Cragmaw goblins, and rumors of Cragmaw Castle somewhere north in the forest. After releasing Droop and letting him flee through the tunnels, the party debates their next move and reviews the leads available to them. They discuss whether to investigate Cragmaw Castle immediately, question Sildar further, or pursue other quests. The group ultimately decides to head toward Wyvern Tor to deal with the orc threat reported near the area.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with the party standing near the bridge after defeating the owlbear on the road to Wyvern Tor. The nearby cave still contains the owlbear’s cubs, and the party has not yet decided whether to investigate it. Their broader objective remains traveling to Wyvern Tor to confront the orcs reported in the area.

title: Bridge Crossing and Caine Taken
overview: The session opens with introductions and a Question of the Day before the party resumes at the broken bridge near the owlbear fight. After confirming the adult owlbear is still fleeing, the group decides not to enter the nearby den and instead focuses on crossing the damaged bridge and continuing toward Wyvern Tor. They successfully get everyone across, although Broc nearly falls into the ravine and Francis and Levon haul him back up by rope. After searching the area, the party finds a cave watched by a lone bugbear and tries to set up an ambush, but Craig is spotted and the plan collapses into open combat. The fight expands as more bugbears, an ogre, and an orc join from the cave, and the battle ends with the enemies dragging Caine deeper inside while the party gives chase.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with Levon charging after the retreating enemies as the party realizes Caine has been taken alive into the cave. The remaining orc threatens Caine with a crossbow, and the group is left facing a hostage situation at the cave entrance. The immediate unresolved goal is rescuing Caine before the enemies can disappear deeper into Wyvern Tor.
scenes: Fight at the Wyvern Tor Cave

title: Caine Departs, Old Owl Well Ahead
overview: The session begins with the party facing a hostage standoff at the cave entrance after the battle at Wyvern Tor, with an orc holding Caine at crossbow point while a bugbear keeps him restrained. Instead of forcing another fight, the group negotiates, gets Caine released, and learns of a red-robed figure with undead at Old Owl Well. Immediately after being freed, Caine decides he cannot continue traveling with the party and announces that he will return to help rebuild the monastery he left behind. Once he departs, the rest of the group searches the cave, finds a strange wall drawing of a crystal-headed goblin, and opens a locked chest filled with magical items and valuables. After resting and sorting the loot, the party heads toward Old Owl Well, where they are ambushed by goblins shortly before reaching the ruins.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with the goblin ambush defeated and the party continuing on without Caine after his departure. They are only a few minutes from Old Owl Well, where the orc said a red-robed man with undead had been seen. The immediate unresolved goal is reaching the ruins and learning what is waiting there.
scenes: Releasing Caine at the Cave Entrance
Goblin Ambush Near Old Owl Well

title: Old Owl Well and Hidden Cells
overview: The party reached Old Owl Well after the goblin ambush and was immediately swarmed by zombies from the ruined tower. After surviving that attack, they spoke with the red-robed necromancer Hamun Kost instead of fighting him, and the exchange turned into a bargain. Kost agreed to share what he knew about the nearby goblins and a cave they were using if the party would seek Agatha and return with an answer he wanted from her. Following his directions, the group located the cave, fought the guards outside, and pushed into the hideout with a more deliberate plan than usual. That plan carried them through the common room and deeper into the complex, where they discovered two prisoners in cells and ended the session with Glasstaff stepping into view.
where_we_left_off: The party ended the session mid-combat inside the prison area with enemies still standing, Blue and Allyanna still locked in cells, and Craig poisoned. The man who appeared from the inner chambers implied the group should have stayed in Phandalin, strongly signaling that the confrontation with Glasstaff is beginning. The immediate unresolved goals are to survive the current fight, free both prisoners, and deal with the leader who has finally shown himself.
scenes: Old Owl Well and Hamun Kost

title: Glasstaff Falls and Craig Moves On
overview: The session resumed in the prison chamber beneath the hideout with Glasstaff finally joining the fight while Blue and Allyanna remained locked in their cells. The party survived his spells, freed both prisoners, and turned the fight in their favor by collapsing on him at close range. Once Levon pinned Glasstaff down, the group forced information out of him about Cragmaw Castle and confirmed that Gundren was likely being held there. They recovered Blue and Allyanna’s belongings, killed Glasstaff after the questioning ended, and searched the room for anything useful. Before leaving, they discovered Droop in another cell, and his reappearance led Craig to decide that this was the right point to leave the party and return to goblin life with the Scraptops.
where_we_left_off: The session ended with Glasstaff dead, Blue and Allyanna freed, and the party finally holding clear directions to Cragmaw Castle. Craig and Droop had just walked away together, leaving the group with two new companions and several choices for what comes next. The unresolved goals are deciding their next stop, following the lead to Cragmaw Castle, and figuring out how Blue and Allyanna fit into the party’s plans.

title: Long Rest and Plans for Agatha
overview: The session opened with introductions and a Question of the Day before shifting into a slower-paced long rest after the recent fights. The party took time to recover, interact, and establish dynamics between newer members like Blue and Allyanna and the rest of the group. During this downtime, they discussed their next objective and focused on the lead involving the banshee Agatha from Hamun Kost. The group weighed what questions to ask and how to approach the encounter, recognizing it as a limited opportunity. Most of the session centered on roleplay, character moments, and planning rather than combat or exploration. By the end, the party settled on moving forward with the Agatha lead as their next major step.
where_we_left_off: The session ended with the party rested, aligned, and ready to pursue the Agatha lead as their next objective. They had not yet reached her location, but their plan and questions were clearly established. The unresolved focus is how the interaction with Agatha will unfold and what information she will provide.
scenes: Discussing Agatha and the Next Lead

title: Banshee Answers and Bridge Ambush
overview: The session began with the Question of the Day before the party resumed speaking with Agatha in Conyberry. After tension around Vexhar, Broc asked about Bojental’s spellbook, and Agatha said she traded it to Tsarnaev of Erebor more than a century ago. The party failed to secure a second question for Hamun Kost and left without his answer. They returned to Old Owl Well, collected payment for clearing the goblin hideout, and made a new information exchange with Hamun. The group then rushed toward Cragmaw Castle and encountered hobgoblins at a bridge.
where_we_left_off: The session ended mid-combat at the bridge on the road toward Cragmaw Castle. Francis was conscious again but badly hurt, and the hobgoblin captain remained engaged with Levon after taking heavy damage. The unresolved danger is whether the party can break through the hobgoblin choke point and continue toward Cragmaw Castle.

title: The Gates of Cragmaw Castle
overview: The session opened by resuming the hobgoblin combat from the previous cliffhanger, with the party picking off the remaining enemies on an elevated bridge structure before Broc's Wild Magic surge ignited the entire wooden gate and bridge, burning them to ash. After a short rest and a brief loot of the fallen hobgoblins, the party pressed on through the Neverwinter Wood and located Cragmaw Castle. They approached from the south, split their scouting between the main wooden door and the castle's arrow slits, and triggered two separate combat encounters, with goblins inside the castle's kitchen area drawing most of the action through blind fire and Vexhar's devastating Shatter spell. The session ended mid-combat with the party fully committed to the southern approach and stealth entirely abandoned.
where_we_left_off: The party is committed to the southern entrance of Cragmaw Castle with all hope of stealth extinguished. The wooden door remains locked and Blue has not yet attempted to pick it. Goblins inside the castle are alerted, and at least one fled toward someone named Yeag elsewhere in the castle. The party is unsure what lies beyond the walls or whether Gundren Rockseeker is present, but the DM confirmed next session will be combat-focused from the start.
scenes: Scouting the Arrow Slits and Phantasmal Force
Combat in the Courtyard: Goblins Through the Arrow Slits

title: Goblins Fall, Bigger Threat Revealed
overview: The session picks up mid-combat at the south entrance of Cragmaw Castle, with the party still outside the walls trading blows with goblins through arrow slits. Blue successfully picks the locked door with thieves' tools after a tense attempt, opening the castle interior to the party. The fight moves inside as Levon kicks open a corridor full of waiting archers, Francis presses deeper into a side hall hunting a fleeing goblin, and Broc detonates a wild magic surge Chromatic Orb that bounces through multiple enemies for massive thunder damage. The party clears room after room across several rounds of combat, killing or routing the last defenders. The session ends when Broc dashes into a northwest tower room and spots a full reinforcement force of hobgoblins and goblin bosses waiting in the corridor beyond, triggering initiative for the next encounter just as the session closes.
where_we_left_off: The party holds the cleared banquet hall and connecting corridors of Cragmaw Castle but is in poor shape heading into the next fight. Levon is bloodied with an arrow wound, most casters are low on resources, and Blue has no bardic inspiration remaining. Brock is positioned at a closed door with an unknown number of hobgoblins and goblin bosses waiting on the other side. Gundren Rockseeker has not been found, and his location within the castle remains unknown.
scenes: Blue Unlocks the Door and Francis Readies
Levon Takes Heavy Fire and the Corridor Clears

title: Into the Castle's Depths
overview: The party resumed combat inside Cragmaw Castle with the group split across several rooms and a tentacle-armed Grick bearing down on Francis. Over the course of the session they cleared two separate engagements, looted a storage room, discovered a disturbing shrine with a blood-soaked altar, and took a short rest in a tower bunkroom. A second hobgoblin patrol ambushed the party during the rest, and the session ended in crisis: Francis at one hit point, Allyanna unconscious from a poison-laced critical hit, and the remaining hobgoblins still in the fight.
where_we_left_off: The session ended mid-combat in the hobgoblin corridor with Francis at 1 hit point prone on the ground and Allyanna unconscious from a poison arrow. Levon is raging in the doorway, Blue is the only party member not badly hurt, and the remaining hobgoblins are still active and pressing. The party has not long rested since before the bugbear fight at the castle's southern entrance, and most casters are critically low on spell slots. Gundren Rockseeker's whereabouts inside Cragmaw Castle remain unknown.
scenes: Grick and Goblin Boss Cleared from the Inner Corridor
Looting the Storage Room and the Shrine
Short Rest in the Southwest Tower
Combat: Hobgoblin Patrol in the Corridor

title: King Grol Meets His Words
overview: Session 22 resumed mid-combat inside Cragmaw Castle with Allyanna unconscious on the ground and Francis barely standing after the previous session's brutal exchange with hobgoblins. The party fought through the remaining enemies, with Francis landing the killing blow to end the first combat, then stabilized their fallen members and took a short rest behind a barricaded door. They discovered two voices beyond a sealed chamber to the north, opened negotiations with King Grol and a mysterious gray-skinned elvish woman, and nearly ransomed Gundren Rockseeker for 750 gold and a bracelet before Vexhar fired a Spellfire Flare through the open doorway and collapsed the deal. Blue killed King Grol with Vicious Mockery before the session ended mid-round, with Gundren on the floor and a direwolf preparing to charge.
where_we_left_off: The session ended mid-combat in King Grol's chamber. Gundren Rockseeker is visible on the floor, alive but badly beaten and unconscious. King Grol is dead. The direwolf that served him has turned its attention toward the party and appears ready to attack. The gray-skinned elvish woman who had been advising King Grol retreated to the north wall and remains an unresolved threat. The party has not yet secured Gundren or cleared the room, and they are heading into level 4.
scenes: Corridor Combat: Bane, Mockery, and Dropping Blue
Listening at the North Door: King Grol Identified
King Grol's Chamber and the Deal's Collapse

title: The Elf They Chose Not to Kill
overview: Session 23 resumed mid-combat in King Grol's chamber, with Broc, Levon, Vexhar, and Allyanna cutting down King Grol's direwolf Snarl while the gray-skinned elvish woman attempted to flee for the door. Francis grappled her before she could escape, and the party spent an extended round of questioning her, learning she served an employer known only as the Spider and had come to the castle on business with King Grol involving Gundren. After she convinced the party to let her go unharmed, Levon searched King Grol's body and Allyanna spent her last pact magic slot on Cure Wounds to wake Gundren, who confirmed that Sildar's old friend Iarno Albrek was the traitor known as Glasstaff. The party made camp outside the castle and reached level four during an uninterrupted long rest. The next morning they escorted Gundren back to Phandalin, restocked and sold loot at Barthen's Provisions, delivered word of Bowgentle's spellbook to Sister Garaele at the Shrine of Luck, and brought Gundren to the townmaster's hall, where he reunited with Sildar. The session ended with Gundren admitting he doesn't know what happened to his missing brothers.
where_we_left_off: The session ended at the townmaster's hall in Phandalin, moments after Gundren and Sildar's reunion. Gundren has confirmed Iarno Albrek was the traitor Glasstaff, but he has no information on the whereabouts of his missing brothers, leaving that thread open. The party has not yet learned more about the Spider's plans or whether the released elvish woman will resurface, and Sildar's trustworthiness remains an open question the table raised but did not resolve.
scenes: Combat: Finishing Snarl and Capturing the Elvish Woman
Questioning and Releasing the Spider's Agent
Looting Grol's Chamber and Reviving Gundren
Long Rest and Reaching Level Four
Sister Garaele and the Shrine of Luck

title: Toasts, Truths, and the Road Ahead
overview: In the aftermath of King Grol's death, the party spends a full day in Phandalin settling business before setting out for Wave Echo Cave. Gundren reveals the true purpose behind his search: a legendary mine holding the Forge of Spells, and asks the party to help him find his missing brothers there in exchange for a share of future profits. The party also breaks the news to Sildar that his old friend Iarno Albrek was secretly Glasstaff, leader of the Red Brands, prompting him to mourn and return Iarno's pouch. Harbin Wester and Sildar both pay out the town's bounties, and Lenine Graywind rewards the party with gold and a standing discount after Francis negotiates on the group's behalf. The evening ends with a rowdy celebration at the Stonehill Inn, where a drinking game leaves Vexhar badly intoxicated. The party agrees to rest for the night and depart for Wave Echo Cave at first light.
where_we_left_off: The party turns in for the night at the Stonehill Inn, most of them drunk or buzzed from the evening's celebration, with Wave Echo Cave and the search for Gundren's missing brothers still waiting on the road ahead. Gundren has agreed to depart at first light. Sildar remains behind in Phandalin to organize the town's defenses and to see to Iarno's remains.
scenes: Gundren Reveals Wave Echo Cave's Secret
Sildar Learns the Truth About Iarno
Bargaining with Lenine at the Coster
A Boisterous Night at the Stonehill Inn

title: Downtime, Departure, and Tharden's Fate
overview: The party spends their final night in Phandalin using downtime actions before setting out for Wave Echo Cave. Training and side pursuits produce mixed results, with Allyanna's impromptu lemon juggling earning the group its only coin of the night. The next morning the party breakfasts with Gundren, settles accounts with Toblin, and debates a name for their company before departing Phandalin's gate. After a roughly five hour trek east into the Sword Mountains, they reach the hidden entrance to Wave Echo Cave and find signs that someone has recently passed through. Venturing inside, they discover an abandoned Rockseeker campsite and the body of Gundren's brother Tharden, killed by an unknown attacker, while his other brother Nundro remains unaccounted for somewhere deeper in the cave.
where_we_left_off: The session ends with Gundren grieving over Tharden's body just past the cave entrance. Nundro's location and fate remain unknown, and the source of the dragging sound and metallic clink Brock heard earlier has not been identified. The party has not yet advanced beyond the entrance chamber into the rest of Wave Echo Cave.
scenes: Morning Departure and the Party's Name
The Trek to Wave Echo Cave

title: Ladders, Stirges, and the Restless Dead
overview: The party accompanied Gundren deeper into Wave Echo Cave, using two combined ladders to descend a twenty foot pit near Tharden's campsite, where they found the corpse of an unfamiliar goblin that had fallen or been pushed from above. Splitting at a fork, the group pressed east together into a wrecked mining cavern lined with skeletons, where six stirges dropped from the ceiling and swarmed Broc, Levon, and Francis before being cut down. Continuing south, they found a dead end with two doors; opening one revealed a chamber wrecked by ceiling collapse containing eight corpses, two of them ogre sized, which rose as undead the moment the party stepped inside. Broc enlarged Levon before retreating to cover, and Levon's raging charge dealt massive damage to one zombie ogre while Eliana revealed a hidden greatsword to cut down two dwarf zombies. The fight dragged on as both ogre zombies proved resistant to death through Undead Fortitude, and the session ended mid fight after a critical hit from the remaining ogre zombie knocked Francis unconscious. Nundro remains unaccounted for, and the party has not yet cleared the guardroom.
where_we_left_off: The session ended mid fight in the wrecked guardroom, with Francis knocked unconscious by a critical hit from the sole remaining ogre zombie while the rest of the undead lay cleared around him. The party chose to stop rather than push through the final round, planning to resume at the top of round three with Allyanna acting first. Nundro remains unaccounted for deeper in Wave Echo Cave, and Francis's condition is the party's immediate concern heading into the next session.
scenes: Splitting Up and Marking the Way
Stirge Swarm in the Miners' Cavern
Two Doors and a Wrecked Barracks

title: Six Flashbacks and the Guardroom's Fall
overview: The session opened with the Question of the Day and a dice roll-off between Vexhar and Francis to decide who would recap the previous session, which Vexhar won. He summarized the party's descent into Wave Echo Cave, the stirge swarm in the mining cavern, and the guardroom ambush that left Francis unconscious. Before combat resumed, each party member relived a personal flashback: Francis remembered his squad's betrayal by Captain Varron Maelor, Allyanna recalled the night a fake blessing on the road to Phandalin became real magic from Solas, Vexhar remembered completing a forbidden summoning ritual that opened contact with a mysterious voice, Broc relived a breakthrough opera performance and a warning from a cloaked patron, Blue recalled her escape from Lintri's Coral Court, and Levon recalled mending a fence on his family farm as his father Alvin predicted he'd eventually leave. Each character received a one-time Flashback Reroll item tied to specific skill checks. The party then finished off the ogre zombies and zombies in the wrecked guardroom, working together to clear the last of the undead. The session ended with the guardroom cleared and the party pausing quietly to take in everything the flashbacks had revealed about each other.
where_we_left_off: With the last zombie destroyed, the wrecked guardroom finally went quiet, and Gundren emerged from cover where he'd been distracting the undead. Francis got back to his feet, breathing and alive after nearly dying twice in the fight. The party paused together in silence, taking in everything the flashbacks had just revealed about each other. Nundro Rockseeker remains unaccounted for somewhere deeper in Wave Echo Cave, and the party has not yet continued exploring beyond the guardroom.
scenes: Allyanna's Flashback: A Blessing Made Real
Blue's Flashback: Escape from the Coral Court

title: The Cloak, the Ghouls, and the Ooze
overview: The party opened with a recap roll-off that earned Francis Heroic Inspiration, then received Tharden's cloak from Gundren and identified it as a Cloak of Protection before handing it to Levon. After searching a ransacked storeroom for a locked strongbox and taking a short rest, the group pushed deeper into Wave Echo Cave, where an attempt to burn a patch of glowing fungus triggered a spore eruption that forced a retreat. The party then opened a door into an old barracks and fought off three ghouls after accidentally alerting them, before pressing north into a cramped mining tunnel maze. Following drag marks tracked by Levon, they were ambushed by an ochre jelly that split into smaller oozes every time it was struck, and the session ended mid-combat with two small fragments of the creature still active.
where_we_left_off: The session ended mid-fight in the cramped mining tunnels, with two small ochre jelly fragments still active against the party. Nundro Rockseeker remains missing somewhere deeper in Wave Echo Cave, and the glowing fungus cavern to the east has not been further examined despite one patch reacting strangely to fire. The party has yet to determine what lies further along the western tunnel the drag marks led them into.
scenes: Storeroom Search Yields a Locked Strongbox
Short Rest and Attuning to the Cloak
Three Paths from the Four-Way Cavern
Ghoul Ambush in the Old Barracks
Tracking Drag Marks Through the Mining Tunnels
Ochre Jelly Splits Apart in the Tunnels

title: The Sunken Skeleton, the Snake, and the Bugbears
overview: The party finished off the last ochre jelly fragments in the cramped mining tunnels, with Levon's Choppy and Broc's Sorcerer's Burst landing the final blows while Gundren looked on impressed. Following Broc's chalk arrow marking their trail, the group found stacked humanoid bones and drag marks along a side tunnel and moved quietly toward a cavern dominated by a black, mussel-lined pool. Using mage hands, a lit candle, and a thrown glowing rock, they located a sunken skeleton and pulled up three jeweled rings and a Wand of Magic Missiles, but the recovery triggered an attack from a giant snake coiled beneath the water. Allyanna's Eldritch Blast and Francis's Talon bloodied the snake before Blue's Silent Image conjured a phantom brown bear that frightened it into fleeing underwater, and the party chose to leave it and move on with their loot. Climbing a stone stairway to a door, Broc overheard goblin-speaking voices inside, and the party armed Levon with the recovered wand before bursting in on six surprised bugbears. The fight left two bugbears dead and the captain asleep from Blue's Sleep spell, ending mid-round with three bugbears still standing as the last conscious one scrambled to rouse his boss.
where_we_left_off: The session ends mid-round inside the bugbear den, with two bugbears dead, the captain asleep from Blue's Sleep spell, and three bugbears — one having briefly dozed off before shaking himself alert — still active and now aware their side is losing. Francis and Levon remain trapped inside the room with the bugbears, both bloodied, while Broc, Allyanna, and Vexhar hold the doorway from outside. The bugbears have not revealed anything about Gundren's missing brother, and the giant snake from the black pool remains alive and hidden somewhere behind the party. Combat will resume at the top of the round next session with Francis on deck.
scenes: Recap Roll-Off and Renewed Battle Positions
Marking the Trail and Tracking Signs
The Black Pool and the Sunken Skeleton
Giant Snake Ambush at the Pool
Recovering the Rings and the Wand

title: A New Zombie and the Spider's Camp
overview: The party finished off the last three bugbears holding the mine's northern quarters, capturing and interrogating the bugbear captain instead of killing him. He revealed that a drow calling himself the Spider, whose real name he gave as Nezznar, had hired his band and left them starving while withholding their pay, so the party sent him off to protect a goblin commune allied with Craig in exchange for his freedom, using a faked illusion mark to keep him honest. During the fight, Broc was grappled and dragged off as a hostage by a fleeing bugbear, forcing several rounds of missed rescue attempts before he broke free himself with a point-blank Sorcerer's Burst. While the party rested, Vexhar heard a voice in his mind urging him to use a sigil branded on his hand, and he reanimated one of the dead bugbears as a zombie familiar, cementing his shift into a Necromancy-focused wizard. Scouting ahead with the zombie, the party found a chamber where a drow matching the captive's description of the Spider was speaking with two bugbears, but decided they were too worn down to engage him and withdrew. Checking a second, barricaded door instead, they discovered a ruined dwarven forge chamber littered with old corpses and dominated by a motionless skull wreathed in green flame, and the session ended there.
where_we_left_off: The session ends the moment the party lays eyes on the floating, green-flame-wrapped skull in the ruined forge chamber, before anyone reacts further. Nundro remains unaccounted for, and the Spider is still camped nearby with two bugbears, unaware the party spotted him. The skull's nature and intentions are completely unknown as the group is left to decide how to approach it.
scenes: Finishing the Fight in the Bugbear Den
The Ruined Forge and the Green Skull

title: Flameskull and Zombie Horde Battle
overview: The party enters the wrecked ore-processing chamber of Wave Echo Cave, avoids engaging a floating green flameskull, and instead descends into a bone-littered cavern strewn with dead dwarves and skeletal remains. Five reanimated corpses lunge from the rubble, and the party fights through a brutal melee that drops Francis unconscious before Eliana's Eldritch Blast finishes the last of them. Searching the chamber afterward stirs a second wave of zombies and draws out the flameskull itself, which unleashes a fireball and a rolling fire sphere that nearly overwhelm the group. The party whittles the flameskull down with Brock's Witch Bolt, a Wand of Magic Missiles shot from Levon, and a final Eldritch Blast from Eliana, then purifies its remains with holy water on Vexhar's advice to keep it from reforming. Gundren reveals the chamber was an ore-smelting room and that the true prize, the Forge of Spells, lies deeper in the cave, but insists on finding his brother Nundro first. Badly wounded, the party retreats from Wave Echo Cave to camp near Phandalin, where Levon's greataxe Choppy is magically upgraded while he carves a strange piece of wood during his watch.
where_we_left_off: The party completes a full long rest just before dawn, restoring their strength after the costly battle against the flameskull and its zombies. Levon's greataxe Choppy has been permanently upgraded to a +1 weapon following the carving event during his watch. The group has still not located Gundren's brother Nundro, has yet to deal with the spider it avoided earlier, and knows the Forge of Spells lies somewhere deeper in the still partially unexplored cave.
scenes: The Flameskull's Fireball and Fire Sphere
Gundren's Warning About the Forge of Spells
Retreat and Long Rest Outside the Cave
Levon's Carved Sapling and Choppy's Upgrade

title: Webs, Darkness, and the Spider's Fall
overview: After a long rest outside Wave Echo Cave, the party returned at dawn with Gundren to hunt down Nezznar the Spider and rescue Nundro Rockseeker. On the way in, they examined the elongated goblin corpse in the pit again and found that neither magic nor anything from the Feywild explained why it was not decomposing. In a pillared hall beneath a great dwarf statue, Nezznar threatened to have Nundro killed and revealed that his operation had flagged Vexhar long before the party arrived, which set the group against each other. When a staged argument failed to fool him, Nezznar trapped the party in webs and kept fighting through darkness and invisibility until Francis grappled him and Allyanna killed him with an Eldritch Blast. Moments later, Nundro escaped his captors and ran straight into the party, who cut down the two bugbears chasing him, and Gundren was reunited with his last living brother.
where_we_left_off: Nezznar and four bugbears lie dead, and Gundren is reunited with Nundro among the fallen bugbears by the stairs. The locked room to the east and the Forge of Spells are still unexplored. The question of who in Nezznar's operation took an interest in Vexhar also remains open. The party will advance to 5th level before the next session.
scenes: Breaking Camp and Returning to the Cave
The Goblin That Will Not Rot

title: A False Brother and the Forge of Spells
overview: The party wraps up in the temple after Nezznar's death, and Gundren leaves for the entrance with the dwarf the party believes is Nundro. Blue opens a locked room with Nezznar's key and finds a second, bound and beaten Nundro, so most of the party rushes back to the entrance. The first Nundro has already vanished outside. A test built on their mother's old nickname proves the prisoner is the real Nundro, and the brothers reunite. The party then finds a hidden shaft in the smelting area, rests, and meets a spectator guarding the Forge of Spells, which refuses them without credentials. While searching a burned out building for those credentials, the party draws out a floating, hateful spirit.
where_we_left_off: The spirit drifts through the wreckage and speaks into the party's minds: "Still warm. I'd forgotten what that looked like. You'll leave something behind when you go. They always do." The spectator still blocks the Forge of Spells, and no one knows who posed as Nundro or where the impostor went. The party reached 5th level during the short rest, and the level up takes effect next session.
scenes: A Second Nundro Behind the Door
Spoils, a New Zombie, and the Forge Question
The Smelter and the Hidden Shaft

title: The Wraith, the Forge, and the Contract
overview: The party opened with a recap from Levon and a Question of the Day, then resumed in the burned room where a wraith named Mormesk attacked. They defeated him in one round of combat, opened his chest, and divided the loot. The party then broke into a boarded storeroom and found a ledger showing the Spectator's guardian contract with Halvard Price had expired. The Spectator released itself from service and vanished. The party tested the Forge of Spells and learned it temporarily enchants weapons and armor, and Francis found a Shield of Tyr. Vexhar chose to stay behind at the forge while the rest of the party carried Tharden's body back to Phandalin.
where_we_left_off: The party arrived in Phandalin around midday with Tharden's body. Vexhar remained alone at the Forge of Spells, researching it. The party still needs to give Tharden a proper burial. Gundren plans to return to the forge soon, and the party has not yet written to Craig about guarding the mine. Paul said the next session picks up with the party in town and Vexhar still at the forge.
scenes: Recap and Question of the Day
Mormesk Appears in the Burned Room
The Spectator and the Expired Contract
Shield of Tyr and Gundren's Trust

title: Fleeing the Forge and Picking Apples
overview: Vexhar stays alone in the Forge of Spells to study it, learns it runs at a fraction of its power, and finds a ledger of lent and sealed items. Four zombies and a ghoul arrive, destroy his zombie of Nezznar, and force him to flee the cave after he casts Darkness. Meanwhile the rest of the party brings Tharden Rockseeker’s body to Phandalin, where Sister Garaele agrees to keep him overnight. The party celebrates at the Stonehill Inn on free drinks, Vexhar arrives with news of the zombies, and Blue casts Charm Person on Francis to get him to bed. The group floats building a bastion at Tresendar Manor, takes a long rest and downtime, and goes apple picking at Daran Edermath’s orchard, ending with six baskets of apples while Harbin Wester still waits.
where_we_left_off: The party walks back toward the Stonehill Inn with six full baskets of apples, and Broc asks what they will do with them. Broc suggests Toblen’s wife might know how to make apple pie. Harbin is still waiting for the party, and the bastion at Tresendar Manor is still only an idea. Vexhar’s undead problem in the Forge of Spells remains unresolved.
scenes: Four Zombies and a Ghoul at the Forge
Tharden Reaches the Shrine of Luck
Free Drinks at the Stonehill Inn
Tankard Prank and Letter to Craig
Broc and Blue Talk About the Feywild
Breakfast and the Apple Picking Vote

title: Tresendar Manor Deed and Sewer Investigation
overview: The party opened the session by answering the Question of the Day and recapping the previous session, then delivered six baskets of apples to the Stonehill Inn. They met Sildar Hallwinter, Gundren Rockseeker, and Harbin Wester at the Townmaster’s Hall, where they gave an account of Wave Echo Cave. Harbin presented them with the deed to Tresendar Manor, and Gundren promised them 10% of the cave’s future profits. Torra Ironwell toured the manor with them, took 150 gold to build personalized rooms, and asked them to investigate a damaged drainage system. The party entered the sewers, fought several swarms of rats, and was addressed by an unknown voice in the dark.
where_we_left_off: The party stood in the damaged chamber after retrieving their Mage Hands when a distant clanking stopped and the room fell silent. A voice with no direction spoke clearly in their minds, calling them creatures who crawl through the stone and asking why they had come. The party has not answered, and the source of the voice and the damage to the pipes remains unknown. Torra Ironwell is waiting for the cause to be found before her crew begins repairs.
scenes: Combat: Rat Swarms in the Drains
Exploring Damaged Pipes and the Flooded Chamber

title: Aboleth Slain Beneath Tresendar Manor, Francis Afflicted
overview: The session opens with a Question of the Day and a recap from Blue of the party’s apple picking, the meeting with Sildar and Gundren, the deed to Tresendar Manor, and the descent into the drains beneath it. In a flooded chamber below the manor, a telepathic aboleth refuses to let the party repair the pipes and demands they serve it. Talks fail, Broc opens combat with Shatter, and the party kills the aboleth after Francis lands a critical hit for 55 damage and Allyanna delivers the final blow. A slimy ichor from the fight clings to Francis and blocks nonmagical healing, and Blue recovers a magical pan flute from the wreckage. Sister Garaele takes a sample of the ichor, and the party heads toward Tharden’s funeral as a festival arrives in Phandalin.
where_we_left_off: The festival has arrived in Phandalin but will not open for a few days, and Tharden is about to be laid to rest. Francis is wrapped in bandages and still afflicted, unable to rest or heal except by magic, and Garaele’s findings are two to four nights away. The origin of the pan flute is unknown, and the aboleth’s last words that its destroyed body will be remembered elsewhere are unexplained.
scenes: Question of the Day and Recap
Combat: Aboleth in the Flooded Chamber
Detect Magic Finds a Pan Flute
Hosing Down at the Ruined Manor
Healing and Curse Removal Attempts Fail

title: Harpers, Remove Curse, and Festival Games
overview: The party answered the Question of the Day, then Paul recapped the tentacled creature beneath Tresendar Manor before the group attended Tharden Rockseeker’s funeral in the rain, where Levon carved the grave marker. After three days of downtime, Blue attuned to the Drowned Pan Flute while Francis suffered repeated acid pain from his unexplained affliction. Sister Garaele delivered a scroll of Remove Curse and revealed that she is a Harper, and the party decided that Vexhar would try to copy the scroll into his spellbook instead of casting it. The party then joined Phandalin’s festival, where they played a fortune teller’s game, entered a cooking contest that Levon won, and competed in an archery contest against Phelan the Red, where Broc tied her score. The session ended halfway through the festival with several games and the prize tent still ahead.
where_we_left_off: Paul ended the session after the archery contest, about halfway through the festival, with the carousel, Fenwin’s cups, the tug of war, and the prize tent still ahead. Broc led the ticket standings, followed by Levon, Allyanna, Vexhar, Francis, and Blue. Francis remains cursed and in pain, and Vexhar has not yet copied the Remove Curse scroll into his spellbook. The goat’s fright toward the old mine road remains unexplained.
scenes: Garaele Delivers Scroll and Harper Secret
Deciding Whether to Cast or Copy
Madame Vane’s Riddles and Card Reading
Harbin Sees Francis Take Acid Damage
Goat Bolts From the Mine Road

title: Festival Games, Mud, and Awards
overview: The party spent the second half of the Phandalin festival playing games and spending tickets while Francis struggled with his curse. They rode the carousel, played Fenwick Fingers Toll’s cup and pea game, and won a tug of war against Big Hollis and a circus crew that had not lost in seven towns. Broc’s Enlarge spell and a wild magic surge blinded the rope line, and Francis discovered that mud on his skin stops the itching from his curse. Five party members bought prizes at Corwin Thistlewick’s novelty tent, and Harbin Wester then handed out awards and named Levon champion of the festival. The night ended with lanterns and fireworks, after Blue noticed a humming dwarven woman that no one else saw and one lantern drifted out over the Old Mine Road.
where_we_left_off: The festival ends with Phandalin asleep and the circus tent dark. Francis remains cursed, with the mud on his skin holding off the itching but drying out and needing frequent reapplication. Vexhar is about halfway through copying the scroll of remove curse, the Harpers’ request for a meeting remains open, and Francis still wants to learn whether the festival prizes carry any meaning. The lantern that drifted out over the Old Mine Road and Blue’s unshared sighting of the humming dwarven woman are unresolved. # **
